name: EPIC 228708009
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 9.8 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 228708009 (K2 campaign 10): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.770384 (16th-84th percentiles 9.614895-9.974631), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 2,171 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.85 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,765 K at its surface.
